eligibility_support.definition: trainord rows with operand_b not in {0, 5}

metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units. The two readers are analysis-only, fitted on each seed's native eligible pool (trainord rows with b not in {0,5}; no resampling) with the AB-qualified AdamW recipe, tuned on V's canonical VAL, evaluated once on the untouched canonical TEST at the best-on-VAL state. Selection is VAL-only; TEST never selects. Majority-class baselines are derived from the corresponding training labels only. The pre-registered ladder, histories and seeds are fixed; every width is reported, including non-fitting ones. V-A/V-B are unchanged.

primary_decision.framing: AH-B (the fit-transfer gap is capacity-insensitive over this ladder)
primary_decision.rule_note: Descriptive categories, no new acceptance thresholds. H1 if some width's held-out Class-A balanced accuracy gains >= +0.15 over the baseline level in >= 4/5 seeds AND reaches >= 0.30; H2 if training fit is present at some level (mean train acc >= 0.50, X's 'training accuracy still low' boundary, or a >= +0.15 gain over baseline in >= 4/5 seeds) while every fitting level's held-out balanced accuracy stays <= 0.25 (chance 0.10); H3 if no level in the ladder fits the training pool; else H4 mixed/inconclusive. H1 takes priority (a transfer signal at any width falsifies capacity-insensitivity); H2/H3 map to the AH-B capacity-insensitive gap. V's V-A/V-B criterion is separate and unchanged.

accessibility.note: V's V-A/V-B criterion is unchanged; the V-B Bayes-gap condition uses U's Class-A Bayes ceiling when the U baseline is available (AH does not redefine the criterion).

ae_bridge.note: AH's baseline level (level_idx 2 -> seed offset 0) re-runs AE's exact heldout-variant fit seed on the same eligible pool under the same recipe; same-environment runs should agree to ~0. Reported, never gating.
